## Why
Types without a build in the checkout, and a tarball that runs everywhere: Node refuses to strip types under `node_modules`, so the tarball ships JavaScript (`docs/local-first.md` §9, §1 item 11).

## What
1. Rename `src/**/*.js` → `.ts` file by file (git renames, minimal diffs), erasable syntax only, `.ts` in every import specifier, `import type` where a name is only a type; `tsconfig.json` gains `verbatimModuleSyntax`, `allowImportingTsExtensions`, `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions`, `outDir: dist`, and drops `checkJs` once nothing is `.js`.
2. `bin/hkb.js` (stays JavaScript): loads `../dist/cli.js` when `dist/` exists and the package has no `.git` beside it, else `../src/cli.ts`; a clear error on a Node older than 22.18 in a checkout.
3. `package.json`: `"prepack": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json"`, `files` gains `dist` and drops `src`; `npm run lint` = `tsc --noEmit` (keep a `node --check` over `bin/` and `scripts/`); `.github/workflows/release.yml` runs `npm ci`-less `npx tsc`? No: `npm install --no-save typescript` then `npm pack`, as `docs/releasing.md` documents.
4. `scripts/smoke-pack.mjs`: unchanged in purpose; it must now prove `dist/` is what runs from the tarball (assert `src/` is absent from the installed package) on 22 and 24 (`test.yml` matrix).
5. `CLAUDE.md`: "Do not add a build step" becomes "no build step to run from a clone; `prepack` builds the tarball in `release.yml` only"; a line saying `typescript` is a devDependency and `npm ci` is never needed to run hkb.

## Done when
- [ ] From a clean clone without `npm install`: `node bin/hkb.js version` works on Node 24.
- [ ] `npm pack` in CI produces a tarball with `dist/` and no `src/`; installed in an empty dir, `hkb doctor` runs on 22 and 24.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke` green; `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs smoke on 22 and 26.
- [ ] The hook command shapes in `src/init.ts` that point at `bin/hkb.js` still resolve in a clone and in an installed package (`test/harness.test.ts`).

## Contract
Last card of the plan on purpose: no seam is renamed. Keep `bin/hkb.js` as JavaScript.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.

**Moved forward, 2026-09-02:** this card now runs directly after track A rather than last, because #312 (the SDK adapter) follows it and the SDK's value is typed configuration.
goal: every src file is .ts and runs directly from a clone on Node 22.18+/24; prepack emits dist/ and the tarball ships it; bin/hkb.js loads dist/ in an installed package and src/ in a checkout; npm run lint runs tsc --noEmit; npm run smoke passes on 22 and 24; zero runtime dependencies
title: TypeScript: native .ts in the checkout, dist/ built by prepack at publish, tsc replacing node --check
